faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our fits, shipping, and quality.

faqs.question: What is the sizing fit like?
faqs.answer: All our tees and hoodies feature a signature boxy, oversized streetwear fit with dropped shoulders. If you prefer a regular or fitted look, consider sizing down.

faqs.question: How long does shipping take?
faqs.answer: Orders are processed within 24-48 hours and typically delivered within 3-5 business days across India with live tracking updates.

faqs.question: What is your return and exchange policy?
faqs.answer: We offer a hassle-free 7-day return and exchange policy from the date of delivery on all unworn items with original tags intact.

faqs.question: How should I care for my oversized graphic tees?
faqs.answer: We recommend machine washing cold inside out with like colors and line drying to preserve the print quality and cotton structure.
